races.paceDynamic: Suddenly I See and Thestral are the confirmed front runners and will contest early fractions over this 1m trip at Musselburgh. With two keen leaders, the early pace should be honest rather than crawling, though not excessively strong given the flat nature of the track. The middle section will see prominent runners Saxon Prince, Mayaada, and Ibn Altheeb tracking, while the hold-up brigade including Alkumatic Jo Jo, Keep An Eye On It, Blues And Royals, and Kameko Fever will need to time their runs from off the pace. This honest gallop favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, rather than pure front runners or deep closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not killing and the prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: The two leaders will soften each other up allowing those tracking in third and fourth to sweep past in the final furlong. Saxon Prince, Mayaada, and Ibn Altheeb are perfectly positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly contested between the two leaders and they tie up
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up a closing kick from the back markers who have conserved energy. Blues And Royals and Kameko Fever both showed recent form suggesting they can finish strongly when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Persists
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easy time and the other folds early
scenarios.body: Suddenly I See or Thestral could steal a march if they get uncontested fractions and kick clear before the closers organize their challenge. The flat Musselburgh track can favor those who get first run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and completely tie up turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the back with the freshest finishers coming from last to first in a dramatic finish. This would require a very strong early pace that destroys the entire front division.

races.paceDynamic: Ice Sovereigns, Samra Green and the potentially returning Applesandpears (now non-runner) leaves just Ice Sovereigns and Samra Green as confirmed front-runners, with Bellarchi and Callianassa likely prominent. This creates a moderate early gallop over the mile trip at Musselburgh, with the pace likely steady rather than frantic given only two definite leaders. The gallop should build progressively through the middle sections as the prominent runners engage. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those with tactical speed who can position themselves just off the pace, as they'll have the most ammunition for the crucial final two furlongs when the early leaders begin to tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves adequate and the race develops into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up specialists will have conserved energy perfectly positioned in the pack before unleashing late runs. Perfect Part and Jannas Journey can use their class and tactical speed to maximum effect in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Bellarchi and Callianassa can position perfectly behind the leaders without doing too much early work
scenarios.body: They can strike at the right moment before the hold-up horses get into gear, using their natural speed. Bellarchi's recent Musselburgh form gives her a significant edge in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Ice Sovereigns and Samra Green can dictate a steady pace that doesn't find them out stamina-wise
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows them to kick again when challenged, with their natural speed carrying them home. Samra Green's class from her Group 2 connections could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a messy sprint from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: Pure speed horses get the jump on the hold-up runners who can't get into the race quick enough. This favours those with natural gate speed who can adapt their running style.

watchPoints.text: Ice Sovereigns and Samra Green both return after 198 days off - market support essential for both front-runners
Perfect Part's early positioning will be crucial as she needs to avoid getting trapped behind the moderate early pace
Bellarchi's reception in betting having won here eight days ago - any negative market moves suggest the step up in class/weight concerns connections
Callianassa's turf form is woeful at 0-9 despite AW success - any confident market support would be significant
The pace through the opening half-mile will determine everything - if too steady the hold-up horses get a perfect setup

races.paceDynamic: Thunder Wonder will lead unopposed through steady fractions, giving the confirmed front-runner ideal conditions at 1m1f. Behind him, Sea Force, Mirsky, Saint Etienne, Sir Paul Ramsey and Dwindling Funds will create a wall of prominent runners fighting for position 2-3 furlongs out. This congestion will compromise each other while Thunder Wonder maintains his advantage and the hold-up horses get organized. The sustainable early pace followed by prominent traffic chaos strongly favors patient horses who can pick their way through late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Profit
scenarios.trigger: If Thunder Wonder maintains his lead while prominent runners neutralize each other in traffic
scenarios.body: The pace collapse allows patient closers to sweep past the stalled prominent pack in the final furlong. Hold-up specialists like James McHenry and Noche Clasica can capitalize on clear runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Thunder Wonder Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner gets loose fractions and the prominent congestion is severe
scenarios.body: Thunder Wonder exploits the lack of early pressure to build an unassailable lead while traffic behind becomes chaotic. His early advantage proves decisive despite moderate recent form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners avoids the traffic and gets first run
scenarios.body: Sea Force or Mirsky finds racing room before the others and capitalizes on their class advantage. The survivor benefits from Thunder Wonder's honest pace while avoiding the squeeze.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Thunder Wonder ties up and all prominent runners get badly hampered
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the back where fitness and finishing kick matter most. Recent runs and race sharpness become crucial factors in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Thunder Wonder's jumping and early positioning - if he misses the break the entire pace dynamic collapses
Traffic developing 2-3 furlongs out involving Sea Force, Mirsky, Saint Etienne and Sir Paul Ramsey causing interference
James McHenry and Noche Clasica getting clear runs in final furlong as the key beneficiaries of pace setup
First-time headgear on Saint Etienne potentially producing improved effort from French import

races.paceDynamic: L'Eagle Aid is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner field and can dictate terms without pressure, likely setting a sustainable gallop over the extended 1m4½f trip. Fox Journey, Sixpack, and Velvet Whisper may press forward but prefer prominent positions rather than outright leading. The majority field comprises hold-up horses including Humble Spark, Made All, Simple Star, and Say What You See who will need the pace to develop. This lack of genuine pace pressure strongly favours front-running and prominent racers who can avoid traffic and dictate their own fate.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If L'Eagle Aid gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The Charlie Johnston-trained gelding can use his tactical advantage to full effect, with the hold-up brigade left with too much to do. His two wins earlier this season came from prominent positions and he faces no early pressure here.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a strong gallop in the final three furlongs. Made All and Say What You See have shown good finishing kicks when the race develops to suit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Fox Journey or Sixpack can track L'Eagle Aid and outfinish him
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigners use their racecourse positioning to perfection, staying close enough to pounce when L'Eagle Aid's effort peaks. Fox Journey drops significantly in grade after his Stoute days.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Course Specialist Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Simple Star's Musselburgh expertise trumps his long absence
scenarios.body: The Dianne Sayer-trained eight-year-old has three course and distance wins and knows every blade of grass here. His 211-day break is a major concern but his local knowledge could prove decisive.

races.paceDynamic: Maldevious is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead in the early stages. Five horses want prominent positions - Kelpie Grey, Ziggy's Condor, Benacre, Polygram, Sea Suite and Invincible Ruby - creating significant congestion and traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up horses Qazaq, Abduction, Cargin Bhui and They All Know Me will be relying on gaps appearing in the straight. This setup strongly favours the lone leader Maldevious and any prominent runners who can secure clear water, as the bunched field behind will struggle for racing room at the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Maldevious gets soft fractions and maintains his lead throughout
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter faces no early pressure and has enough left to resist late challenges. The crowded prominent group behind gets in each other's way, allowing the leader to stay clear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Breakaway Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners breaks clear from the pack 2f out
scenarios.body: Either Kelpie Grey or Ziggy's Condor finds the gap at the right moment and pulls away from the congested field. Their superior pace positioning proves decisive over the struggling hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and gaps open for the back markers
scenarios.body: The prominent group goes too fast chasing Maldevious and comes back to the hold-up horses late. Abduction or Cargin Bhui get clear runs and finish strongest when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can get a clear run in the straight
scenarios.body: The bunched field creates a messy finish with multiple hard-luck stories and interference. The winner emerges more through luck than judgement from the scrimmaging pack.

races.paceDynamic: Right And Exact will lead from the gates with no obvious challenger for the early lead, allowing him to dictate sustainable fractions. The real danger develops behind as Pop Star, Blind Beggar, South Parade, Equity Law, Emerald Harmony, Al Hussar and Kinetic Force all want prominent positions in a 17-runner sprint, creating inevitable traffic problems. This congestion will peak at the 2-3 furlong marker when the prominent brigade tries to fan out simultaneously. The lack of early pace pressure combined with inevitable traffic chaos strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and deliver late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners bunch up and create interference 2-3 furlongs out
scenarios.body: Right And Exact's honest gallop sets up a messy scramble behind where hold-up horses with clear runs prosper. The pace collapse allows closers to pick off the struggling prominently-raced field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Clean Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Right And Exact gets an uncontested lead and the field strings out cleanly
scenarios.body: The honest leader proves hard to peg back when getting soft fractions and the prominent horses can't organize a serious challenge. His stamina-laden pedigree thrives in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners manage to avoid serious interference and organize their challenge
scenarios.body: The superior class of the well-positioned speedsters tells as they get first run on the leaders without major trouble. Quick horses with tactical pace dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Right And Exact sets very slow early fractions and gets caught napping
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine early pace allows a patient hold-up horse to unleash a devastating late burst from the back. The entire field comes back to the closers in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Right And Exact must be monitored for market support given his 222-day absence and unproven handicap credentials
